triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER a_guard_final_work_order BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_final_work_order()

CREATE TRIGGER contract_administrative_installation_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, client_id, contract_id ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION contract_administrative_installation_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_material_installation BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_rejected_material_closure()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_completed_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_installation_completed_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_current_crew BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_job_completion_crew('installation')
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_reset_alerta BEFORE UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reset_alerta_enviada()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_reverse_on_cancel AFTER UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'cancelled'::installation_status) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::installation_status))) EXECUTE FUNCTION reverse_inventory_on_installation_cancel()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_reverse_on_delete BEFORE DELETE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reverse_inventory_on_installation_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_single_active_job BEFORE UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_single_active_job('installation')
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_validate_completion BEFORE UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_installation_completion()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_track_work_session AFTER UPDATE ON public.installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION track_job_work_session('installation')
CREATE TRIGGER fase162_inventory_unit_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.inventory_units FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_routine_inventory_unit()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_inventory_units_onu_limit_on_contract_update BEFORE UPDATE OF contract_id ON public.inventory_units FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_inventory_units_onu_limit_on_contract_update()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_inventory_units_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.inventory_units FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
